tytul: Indian eggplant pickle in oil: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for Indian-style eggplant (brinjal) pickle in oil with spices.

ostrzezenia.tekst: There are no validated processes for vegetables and herbs in oil made at home; in the USA, the rules for such products apply only to commercial processors.
Appearance, smell and taste cannot tell you whether vegetables in oil carry a botulism hazard.
The safest recommendation for vegetables and herbs in oil is to freeze them; if they are not frozen, keep them in the refrigerator and eat them within 4 days or throw them away.

akapity: Peppers, garlic, mushrooms and eggplant have been involved in botulism outbreaks from vegetables and herbs in oil, mostly homemade products.
In Italy in 1993, two type B botulism outbreaks were linked to commercially prepared roasted eggplant in oil.
Eggplant is a low-acid food with a pH above 4.6, and no USDA process times have been developed for canning it at home.
